title: Get your custom domain through Beacons
summary: Beacons is a free, all-in-one platform with the best link in bio, media kit builder, online store and email marketing tool for creators on Instagram + Tiktok
body_markdown:
Through purchasing a custom domain, you can change your[beacons.ai/username](http://beacons.ai/username) website link to any domain of your choosing. Your page can then be truly customized from link to appearance! 🚀


Learn more about how Beacons pricing plans empower creator monetization by offering custom social media[tools for content creators and influencers](https://beacons.ai/i/plans) . Specifically, you can: 💪


-


Use a custom domain with your Beacons page for just $10/mo


-


Buy a custom domain through Beacons for as little as $4 (for first time purchasers)


-


Link domains that you already own (i.e., that you bought elsewhere prior) to your Beacons page


-


Get set up services and support for any domain(s) you purchase through Beacons


To purchase a custom domain,


-


Navigate to "site settings" in the top right hand drop down after clicking on your profile image


-


Follow the 2 steps under "custom domains" at the top left


And voila - you're all set with your own custom domain and site! ❤️


Share your custom domain pages with us via[Twitter](https://twitter.com/beaconsai) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/beacons.ai/?hl=en) ! We're excited to see what you've built 🥳
